reason: Only the ignored local-validator lifecycle tests read this file; no binary reads it. challenge_period_seconds lets the main lifecycle test observe escape finalization in a bounded run. note_ttl_seconds is read only by the ignored expired-claim lifecycle test, on a stack started with a clock offset (scripts/localnet/stack.mjs --clock-before-utc-midnight), so a note's UTC-day expiry bucket passes within minutes. The production server rejects a vault whose challenge period or note TTL differs from shared.json, and its settlement/challenger timing inequality also rejects 40 seconds.
